concept: Create a complete UI concept screenshot for a minimal Chinese interactive Three.js ceramic object viewer, landscape 1440x960. Purpose: observe geometry and PBR material of the supplied type of Guangcai porcelain tall cylindrical lidded cup with saucer. Neutral medium light gray seamless studio background. Large centered photoreal smooth perfectly circular white porcelain cylinder, true flat wide gold edged ribbon handle on right, narrow intricate multicolored botanical goldground vertical strip ONLY behind handle, otherwise white; white thin round lid with gold edge and gold-sided arched bridge knob with fine transverse lines; shallow white saucer gold rim, narrow floral outer rim. Large object at 3/4. Compact top-left title '广彩 · 器物' and tiny secondary '一号杯 · 花纹展示'. Top right two understated text buttons '自动旋转' '复位'. Bottom horizontal small native text view buttons '整体' '正面' '把手' '俯视' '杯底' '拆解' '杯盖'. Bottom left discreet instructions '拖拽旋转 · 滚轮缩放'. Right edge one small '材质与图案' button opens settings, no visible large panel by default. No marketing, no product price, no hero eyebrow, no decorative page elements, no grids, no unnecessary badges, no fake metrics. UI must be achievable code-native typography and buttons separate from the live 3D object. Professional restrained readable design, neutral palette, tiny dark muted red selected control accent. All primary screen represented, ample negative space. This is design reference only, model will be real 3D.
body: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a FLAT 2D albedo decal print master for a Canton famille rose Guangcai porcelain cup. Output portrait aspect 1:2 at highest available detail. Fill the entire canvas edge to edge with exquisite dense traditional Chinese hand-painted flowers, fruits, butterflies and foliage, on a perfectly FLAT UNIFORM ochre gold ground color #B3924F. The gold ground is matte flat ink for a later PBR mask, NOT rendered metallic. Multiple distinct small pink/red peonies with many delicate petals, pale cream chrysanthemum with fine red contours, coral and rose pink lotus, turquoise jade green leaves with very fine dark green veins, occasional pomegranate fruit, two tiny pale yellow/red butterflies, little white blossoms. Refined intricate enamel decal linework matching finely painted Chinese porcelain; elegant asymmetrical botanical intertwining, many varied smaller motifs, not big cartoon flowers, crisp thin precise outlines, richly detailed fine brushwork with lightly layered pigment inside petals, balanced 30% visible uniform ochre gold background negative spaces. No recognizable repeats within the image. The vertical edges and top/bottom must tile seamlessly with matching stems and background. Front-on flat scan style, constant color, no illumination or shadows whatsoever. No container, cup, saucer, handle, object mockup, borders, margins, text, logo, watermarks, labels, embossing, specular highlight, texture of paper, grain, perspective, cast shadow, baked light, gradients in gold. Gold must stay homogeneous separate from multicolored enamel so semantic color segmentation can make an aligned metal mask. This is newly reconstructed artwork inspired by photographed ceramic decoration, not a photo crop.
band: Use case illustration-story. Create a very wide horizontal 6:1 flat 2D ceramic decal strip, maximum detailed resolution. Entire rectangle edge to edge, no borders, no margins. Continuous dense traditional Canton famille rose Guangcai botanical enamel: many small different pink peonies, red camellias, pale ivory chrysanthemums, lotus buds, tiny yellow/red butterflies, jade/turquoise green leaves with thin dark contours and fine veins, occasional pomegranate. Flowers mostly fit within the strip height. About 14 distinct flower groupings across width, asymmetrical organic densely entwined finely painted miniature pattern, NO obvious identical repetitions. Exact homogeneous flat ochre gold ground #B3924F throughout all negative spaces, no metallic shading. Ends left/right join SEAMLESSLY with same flat gold ground and matching plant stems. This is a print albedo master for a narrow saucer rim, NOT a photo. Absolutely flat scan view, no ceramic object, no camera perspective, no shadows, no lighting, no highlights, no rough surface, no paper grain, no embossing, no bevels, no text. Each petal and vein and butterfly wing has precise delicate linework. Use a traditional Chinese porcelain enamel painting look, not vector clipart or cartoon. Gold background must be separable by color for an aligned PBR mask. New reconstruction inspired by ceramic motifs, not an official print master.
